steps.en: Install the extension from the Chrome Web Store
steps.zh: 从 Chrome 商店安装扩展

steps.en: Register the MCP entry in your agent config
steps.zh: 在 agent 配置里注册 MCP 条目
steps.code: claude mcp add --transport stdio pointa -- npx -y pointa-server

steps.en: Starts a local HTTP daemon and file store under ~/.pointa
steps.zh: 拉起本地 HTTP daemon，状态存进 ~/.pointa

steps.en: Open the localhost app, click the icon, annotate elements
steps.zh: 打开 localhost 应用，点扩展图标，给元素钉批注

steps.en: Anchors feedback per page and route, with screenshots for bug reports
steps.zh: 批注按页面和路由锚定，bug 报告可带截图

steps.en: Optionally wrap the dev command to capture backend logs
steps.zh: 可选：包一层 dev 命令截后端日志

steps.en: The agent reads the annotations over MCP when you say implement
steps.zh: 你说一句实现，agent 就经 MCP 把批注读走

value.en: Designers and QA hand the coding agent Figma-style feedback without ever touching the repo.
value.zh: 设计和 QA 把 Figma 式反馈递给编码 agent，全程不碰仓库。
